summary: Tested Bot Logo Upload feature - all backend APIs and frontend UI components working correctly. Logo upload, serve, delete, and Discord sync endpoints all functional. ChatWidget correctly displays uploaded logo in bot avatars with graceful fallback to default icon when no logo is uploaded.
seed_data_creation: Re-uploaded test logo for instance 88bfae82-2533-4235-968d-b3298fd57073 after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bot Logo feature fully tested. The Bot Settings page at /admin/settings shows a 'Bot Avatar' section at the top of the Identity card with Upload/Replace/Remove/Sync to Discord buttons. Logo is stored in Emergent Managed object storage and served publicly at /api/bot-logo/{instance_id}. ChatWidget at /widget?instance=<id> displays the logo in header and bot message avatars. embed.js script probes for logo and sets trigger button image if found.

features_tested.details: Accepts PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF images up to 2MB, stores in object storage, saves path to bot_config
Returns image with correct content-type, publicly accessible without auth
Removes logo reference from bot_config, subsequent GET returns 404
Requires logo to be uploaded first, attempts to update Discord bot avatar via API

features_tested.feature: Bot Settings page - Bot Avatar section
features_tested.details: Shows avatar circle, Upload/Replace button, Remove button (when logo exists), Sync to Discord button
Header avatar shows uploaded logo image

features_tested.feature: ChatWidget - Logo in bot message avatars
features_tested.details: Bot message avatars show uploaded logo image
When no logo uploaded, shows default Bot SVG icon
Script probes /api/bot-logo/{instance}, sets trigger button to logo on success, falls back to chat icon on error
